# Third-party: Daniel Franzen's ARC-AGI-3 Milestone 2 notebook

`arc-agi-3-milestone-2-solution.ipynb` is an unchanged copy of the public Kaggle
notebook `dfranzen/arc-agi-3-milestone-2-solution` (version downloaded
2026-10-19), which builds on Tufa Labs' Duck harness (Jeroen Cottaar and Tufa
Labs). Franzen's repository github.com/da-fr/arc-agi-3-solution is licensed
Apache-2.0; the harness `ARC3-Inference` declares the MIT classifier in its
pyproject. The notebook's own header says: "Third-party code and model weights
remain subject to their respective licenses."

`scripts/kaggle_duck_notebook.py` derives our kernel from this file by string
patches on named cells, so every change we make is visible in that script.
Nothing in this directory is edited by hand.
